description: Return a normalized side-by-side comparison of two to ten ETFs across selected classification, market, fund-data, cost, income, benchmark, price-performance, price-risk, and holdings modules. Leaders are mechanical extrema, not recommendations. Currency and partial-holdings caveats are explicit. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

performanceDays.description: Window in calendar days back from each fund's newest close; the start is the last close on or before that day. 365 matches the fund page and the screener's 1-year return.

tickers.description: Two to ten exact Bullrun ETF listing tickers.
